source_refs.note: 2. Agricultural Activities: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Agricultural activities contribute significantly to water pollution through the runoff of fertilizers, pesticides, and herbicides into nearby water bodies. Poor irrigation practices can increase soil erosion, washing sediments into rivers and streams. In many areas, drainage from farmlands carries pollutants that contaminate both surface and groundwater sources.
